title: Deadly Dragon Egg
description: This egg is perfect for smp with no plugin, this eggs gives the holder potion effects when they hold the egg, the effects can be removed if the egg leave the inventory, the effects can be customized in the config file
body:
The Deadly Dragon Egg plugin just got a **new update**.

The old features are still here. The Dragon Egg still gives players powerful potion effects, and the holder can still glow while carrying the egg. The glow system is still controlled by the config, so server owners can enable or disable glow and change the glow color.

But now, the plugin has new features too.

Players can right-click the Dragon Egg while holding it in their main hand to open a custom effect menu. From there, they can choose which potion effect they want the egg to give them. The GUI is fully controlled by the config file, so server owners can choose which effects appear, what icon each effect uses, what slot it appears in, and whether the effect is enabled or disabled.

Another new feature is drop protection. When a player drops the Dragon Egg, the egg effect and glow are removed from that player. This makes sure the powers only stay with the person who actually has the egg.

The plugin also now protects normal potion effects. If a player already has effects from potions, beacons, commands, or other plugins, the Dragon Egg will not wipe those effects forever when switching egg powers.

# New features added:

- Right-click Dragon Egg GUI
- Config-controlled effect menu
- Config-controlled effect icons and slots
- Players can choose their egg effect
- Selected effect saves for each player
- Switch cooldown support
- Egg effects removed when the egg is dropped
- Glow removed when the egg is dropped
- Normal potion effects are protected

# Old features still included:

- Dragon Egg gives potion effects
- Config-controlled effects
- Config-controlled amplifiers
- Config-controlled glow
- Config-controlled glow color
- Effects only work when the player has the egg

This update makes the Dragon Egg feel more powerful, more customizable, and more useful for SMP servers.
